description_en: Selects the screen-space primitive rendered for each chosen unit instance.
description_zh: 选择为每个匹配单位实例绘制的屏幕空间图元。

description_en: Chooses whether the overlay is drawn below or above the native HUD.
description_zh: 选择覆盖层绘制在原版 HUD 下方还是上方。

description_en: Anchors the overlay rectangle to a screen edge corner or center.
description_zh: 将覆盖层矩形锚定到屏幕边缘、角落或中心。

description_en: Selects all matching units or one deterministic representative including camera-distance modes.
description_zh: 选择全部匹配单位或一个确定性的代表实例并支持按镜头距离选择。

description_en: Chooses gap-free frame indices stable lifetime indices or an explicit slot expression for layout.
description_zh: 选择无空位帧编号、生命周期稳定编号或显式槽位表达式用于排布。

description_en: Filters source unit instances relative to the local player team.
description_zh: 按与本地玩家队伍的关系筛选来源单位实例。

description_en: Prevents hidden unit information from reaching the HUD unless explicitly relaxed.
description_zh: 默认阻止隐藏单位信息进入 HUD；只有显式配置才会放宽。

description_en: Controls drawing after an instance has received its index and layout context.
description_zh: 实例取得编号与排布上下文后控制是否绘制。

description_en: Filters instances before selection count and compact numbering are calculated.
description_zh: 在选择、计数和紧凑编号前筛选实例。

description_en: Ranks candidates for highestPriority and lowestPriority instance modes.
description_zh: 为最高或最低优先级的单实例模式提供动态排序值。

description_en: Provides the explicit integer layout slot and overlaySlot value.
description_zh: 提供显式整数排布槽位与 overlaySlot 值。

description_en: Limits the number of selected instances drawn by this overlay definition.
description_zh: 限制此覆盖层定义最多绘制的实例数量。

description_en: Sets the number of columns used to derive overlayRow and overlayColumn.
description_zh: 设置用于计算 overlayRow 与 overlayColumn 的列数。

description_en: Offsets the anchored rectangle horizontally and can use overlay layout functions.
description_zh: 水平偏移锚定矩形，并可使用覆盖层排布函数。

description_en: Offsets the anchored rectangle vertically and can use overlay layout functions.
description_zh: 垂直偏移锚定矩形，并可使用覆盖层排布函数。

description_en: Adds horizontal spacing between automatic grid cells.
description_zh: 为自动网格单元添加水平间距。

description_en: Adds vertical spacing between automatic grid cells.
description_zh: 为自动网格单元添加垂直间距。

description_en: Sets runtime overlay width; images default to native width.
description_zh: 设置运行时覆盖层宽度；图片默认使用原始宽度。

description_en: Sets runtime overlay height; images default to native height.
description_zh: 设置运行时覆盖层高度；图片默认使用原始高度。

description_en: Applies a uniform runtime scale around the overlay center; negative values mirror both axes.
description_zh: 以覆盖层中心为轴应用统一动态缩放；负值会同时镜像两个轴。

description_en: Multiplies the horizontal runtime scale and supports mirroring.
description_zh: 乘算水平方向动态缩放并支持镜像。

description_en: Multiplies the vertical runtime scale and supports mirroring.
description_zh: 乘算垂直方向动态缩放并支持镜像。

description_en: Rotates the overlay clockwise around its center using a runtime expression.
description_zh: 使用动态表达式使覆盖层绕中心顺时针旋转。

description_en: Multiplies all primitive and text alpha after clamping to zero through one.
description_zh: 将所有图元和文字透明度乘以限制在零到一的动态值。

description_en: Orders overlay draws from lower values to higher values.
description_zh: 按从低到高的动态值决定覆盖层绘制顺序。

description_en: Loads an image with the native unit INI resource path rules.
description_zh: 按原版单位 INI 资源路径规则加载图片。

description_en: Selects native smoothing while loading an overlay image.
description_zh: 选择加载覆盖层图片时是否使用原版平滑。

description_en: Selects and clamps the current zero-based image atlas frame.
description_zh: 动态选择并限制从零开始的图片图集帧。

description_en: Declares the number of image atlas frames using the native Decal-compatible spelling.
description_zh: 使用与原版 Decal 兼容的字段名声明图片图集帧数。

description_en: Sets atlas frame width; omit with frame_height for automatic one-row or one-column slicing.
description_zh: 设置图集帧宽；与 frame_height 一同省略时自动按单行或单列切分。

description_en: Sets atlas frame height; omit with frame_width for automatic one-row or one-column slicing.
description_zh: 设置图集帧高；与 frame_width 一同省略时自动按单行或单列切分。

description_en: Orders atlas frame indices down columns before advancing right like native Decal.
description_zh: 像原版 Decal 一样先沿列向下再向右排列图集帧编号。

description_en: Uses another image Overlay as an alpha mask source; the source is hidden unless maskRender is true.
description_zh: 使用另一个图片 Overlay 作为透明度遮罩源；除非 maskRender 为 true 否则来源不会显示。

description_en: Uses reusable geometry in the content Overlay's unscaled local coordinates as a binary mask.
description_zh: 在内容 Overlay 未缩放的局部坐标中使用可复用 geometry 作为二值遮罩。

description_en: Allows an Overlay used as a mask source to remain visibly rendered.
description_zh: 允许作为遮罩来源的 Overlay 继续正常显示。

description_en: Rejects sampled mask alpha below a dynamic clamped threshold.
description_zh: 拒绝低于动态且限制到零至一阈值的遮罩透明度。

description_en: Inverts sampled mask alpha before threshold treatment.
description_zh: 在阈值处理前反转采样到的遮罩透明度。

description_en: Retains accepted alpha converts it to one or remaps threshold through one onto zero through one.
description_zh: 保留通过阈值的透明度、转为一或将阈值至一重映射为零至一。

description_en: Combines content and mask alpha by multiplication minimum or replacement while retaining content RGB.
description_zh: 通过相乘、取最小值或替换来组合内容与遮罩透明度并保留内容 RGB。

description_en: Includes the source Overlay's dynamic alpha and color alpha in mask sampling.
description_zh: 在遮罩采样中包含来源 Overlay 的动态 alpha 和颜色透明度。

description_en: Sets bar fill text color or image tint using native color syntax.
description_zh: 使用原版颜色语法设置血条填充、文字颜色或图片染色。

description_en: Sets the background color of bar overlays.
description_zh: 设置条形覆盖层的背景颜色。

description_en: Sets the border color of bar overlays.
description_zh: 设置条形覆盖层的边框颜色。

description_en: Sets bar border width; zero disables the border.
description_zh: 设置条形覆盖层边框宽度；零会关闭边框。

description_en: Provides the current bar value before zero-through-one ratio clamping.
description_zh: 提供计算并限制到零至一前的条形当前值。

description_en: Provides the positive maximum used for the bar ratio.
description_zh: 提供条形比例使用的正最大值。

description_en: Chooses the direction in which a bar fills.
description_zh: 选择条形覆盖层的填充方向。

description_en: Uses native localized text and percent-brace dynamic resolvers.
description_zh: 使用原版本地化文字与百分号花括号动态解析。

description_en: Sets dynamic text size for text overlays and bar labels.
description_zh: 设置文字覆盖层和条形标签的动态字号。

description_en: Sets bar-label color independently of the bar fill.
description_zh: 独立于条形填充设置条形标签颜色。

description_en: Aligns text within the overlay rectangle.
description_zh: 在覆盖层矩形内对齐文字。

description_en: Returns the gap-free selected instance index for this frame.
description_zh: 返回当前帧所选实例的无空位编号。

description_en: Returns an index retained for the source unit lifetime; removed units leave gaps.
description_zh: 返回来源单位生命周期内保持稳定的编号；移除后会留下空位。

description_en: Returns the number of selected instances before isVisible drawing gates.
description_zh: 返回 isVisible 绘制门控前的已选实例数量。

description_en: Returns the automatic grid row for the active instance.
description_zh: 返回当前实例的自动网格行号。

description_en: Returns the automatic grid column for the active instance.
description_zh: 返回当前实例的自动网格列号。

description_en: Returns the evaluated explicit slot or compact index fallback.
description_zh: 返回求值后的显式槽位或紧凑编号后备值。

description_en: Returns the native runtime ID of the source unit as a number.
description_zh: 以数字形式返回来源单位的原版运行时 ID。

description_en: Returns current HUD canvas width.
description_zh: 返回当前 HUD 画布宽度。

description_en: Returns current HUD canvas height.
description_zh: 返回当前 HUD 画布高度。

description_en: Returns the current native UI scale reported by the HUD renderer.
description_zh: 返回 HUD 渲染器报告的当前原版 UI 缩放。

description_en: Uses another single-image native Decal as an aligned alpha mask source.
description_zh: 使用另一个单图片原版 Decal 作为对齐的透明度遮罩来源。

description_en: Uses reusable geometry in the content Decal's unscaled local pixel coordinates as a binary mask.
description_zh: 在内容 Decal 未缩放的局部像素坐标中使用可复用 geometry 作为二值遮罩。

description_en: Allows a Decal used as a mask source to remain visibly rendered.
description_zh: 允许作为遮罩来源的 Decal 继续正常显示。

description_en: Rejects sampled mask alpha below a dynamic clamped threshold.
description_zh: 拒绝低于动态且限制到零至一阈值的遮罩透明度。

description_en: Inverts sampled mask alpha before threshold treatment.
description_zh: 在阈值处理前反转采样到的遮罩透明度。

description_en: Retains accepted alpha converts it to one or remaps threshold through one onto zero through one.
description_zh: 保留通过阈值的透明度、转为一或将阈值至一重映射为零至一。

description_en: Combines content and mask alpha by multiplication minimum or replacement while retaining content RGB.
description_zh: 通过相乘、取最小值或替换来组合内容与遮罩透明度并保留内容 RGB。

description_en: Includes the source Decal's dynamic alpha and configured color alpha in mask sampling.
description_zh: 在遮罩采样中包含来源 Decal 的动态 alpha 和配置颜色透明度。

description_en: Adds a runtime condition to this mutator's dynamic damage multipliers; self is the firing unit and eventSource is the hit target.
description_zh: 为该 mutator 的动态伤害倍率添加运行时条件；self 是发射单位，eventSource 是命中目标。

description_en: Extends the native direct damage multiplier with runtime math; native numeric values without ifCondition remain completely native.
description_zh: 将原版直击伤害倍率扩展为运行时数学表达式；未搭配 ifCondition 的普通数字仍完全走原版。

description_en: Extends the native area damage multiplier with runtime math; rules retain INI declaration order.
description_zh: 将原版范围伤害倍率扩展为运行时数学表达式；规则保持 INI 声明顺序。

description_en: Selects the replacement projectile for this ordered turret rule; the first matching rule wins.
description_zh: 指定该炮塔有序规则替换成的弹射物；首个匹配规则生效。

description_en: Adds a dynamic resource memory or target-state condition; self is the shooter and eventSource is the attack target.
description_zh: 添加可读取 resource、memory 或目标状态的动态条件；self 是发射者，eventSource 是攻击目标。

description_en: Requires at least one listed runtime tag on the attack target.
description_zh: 要求攻击目标至少具有一个列出的运行时标签。

description_en: Rejects the rule when the attack target has any listed runtime tag.
description_zh: 当攻击目标具有任一列出标签时跳过该规则。

description_en: Allows overkill damage to leave this custom unit with HP below zero whenever the runtime condition is true.
description_zh: 当运行时条件为真时，允许过量伤害使此自定义单位的生命值降到零以下。

description_en: Centers the local owning player's camera at runtime-evaluated absolute world coordinates.
description_zh: 将本机玩家视角居中到运行时求值的绝对世界坐标。

description_en: Moves the local owning player's camera by a runtime-evaluated world-space offset.
description_zh: 按运行时求值的世界坐标偏移量移动本机玩家视角。

description_en: Centers the camera on any native UnitReference or the contextual actionTarget point; the trailing world-axis X/Y offsets are optional together and default to zero.
description_zh: 将视角居中到任意原版 UnitReference 或上下文 actionTarget 点；尾部世界轴 X/Y 偏移整体选填且默认均为零。

description_en: Sets the native smoothed camera zoom target from a runtime expression.
description_zh: 根据运行时表达式设置原版平滑视角缩放目标。

description_en: Clears native camera momentum when the runtime condition is true.
description_zh: 当运行时条件为真时清除原版摄像机惯性。

description_en: Selects the finite geometry mask type.
description_zh: 选择有限几何遮罩的类型。

description_en: Sets the outer radius for circle sector ring and arc masks.
description_zh: 设置圆形、扇形、圆环和圆弧遮罩的外半径。

description_en: Sets the horizontal radius of an ellipse.
description_zh: 设置椭圆的水平半径。

description_en: Sets the vertical radius of an ellipse.
description_zh: 设置椭圆的垂直半径。

description_en: Sets rectangle width or line length.
description_zh: 设置矩形宽度或线段长度。

description_en: Sets rectangle height.
description_zh: 设置矩形高度。

description_en: Sets the empty inner radius of sectors and rings.
description_zh: 设置扇形和圆环的内部空心半径。

description_en: Sets the starting angle in game degrees for sectors and arcs.
description_zh: 设置扇形和圆弧以游戏角度表示的起始角。

description_en: Sets the signed angular sweep of sectors and arcs.
description_zh: 设置扇形和圆弧带方向的扫过角度。

description_en: Rotates the completed mask in game degrees.
description_zh: 以游戏角度旋转最终遮罩。

description_en: Offsets the completed mask horizontally before an action anchor is applied.
description_zh: 在应用动作锚点前水平偏移最终遮罩。

description_en: Offsets the completed mask vertically before an action anchor is applied.
description_zh: 在应用动作锚点前垂直偏移最终遮罩。

description_en: Sets line or arc stroke thickness.
description_zh: 设置线段或圆弧的描边厚度。

description_en: Defines polygon vertices in local coordinates.
description_zh: 以局部坐标定义多边形顶点。

description_en: Lists masks consumed by union intersection or difference.
description_zh: 列出并集、交集或差集所使用的遮罩。

description_en: Selects how the geometry changes per-team fog state.
description_zh: 选择几何遮罩如何修改每队的迷雾状态。

description_en: Selects the geometry mask used by this fog definition.
description_zh: 选择此迷雾定义使用的几何遮罩。

description_en: Selects teams whose fog maps are changed.
description_zh: 选择要修改迷雾图的队伍。

description_en: Selects a world-space anchor from any native UnitReference or the contextual actionTarget point; follow=true reevaluates it.
description_zh: 从任意原版 UnitReference 或上下文 actionTarget 点选择世界坐标锚点；follow=true 时会重新求值。

description_en: Reapplies the fog operation for this duration; negative values last until session end.
description_zh: 在指定秒数内持续重放迷雾操作；负数会持续到本局结束。

description_en: Re-evaluates geometry and anchor while its runtime condition is true; otherwise uses the initial snapshot.
description_zh: 运行时条件为真时重新计算几何与锚点；否则使用初始快照。

description_en: Applies reusable fog definitions from a custom action.
description_zh: 从自定义动作执行可复用的迷雾定义。

description_en: Changes the global fog mode and initializes missing team fog maps as unexplored.
description_zh: 修改全局迷雾模式，并将缺失的队伍雾图初始化为未探索。

description_en: Raises a number to a custom power.
description_zh: 计算自定义指数幂。

description_en: Returns e raised to x.
description_zh: 计算 e 的 x 次幂。

description_en: Returns the natural logarithm.
description_zh: 计算自然对数。

description_en: Returns the base-10 logarithm.
description_zh: 计算以 10 为底的对数。

description_en: Returns a logarithm using a custom base; invalid domains produce NaN.
description_zh: 计算自定义底数的对数；无效定义域返回 NaN。

description_en: Returns the cube root.
description_zh: 计算立方根。

description_en: Returns the absolute value.
description_zh: 返回绝对值。

description_en: Rounds downward.
description_zh: 向下取整。

description_en: Rounds upward.
description_zh: 向上取整。

description_en: Rounds to the nearest integer.
description_zh: 四舍五入到最近整数。

description_en: Returns -1 0 or 1 for the sign.
description_zh: 根据符号返回 -1、0 或 1。

description_en: Clamps a number to an inclusive range.
description_zh: 将数值限制在闭区间内。

description_en: Linearly interpolates between two values.
description_zh: 在两个数值之间线性插值。

description_en: Returns the unbounded interpolation parameter of x.
description_zh: 返回 x 对应的不受限插值参数。

description_en: Returns the Euclidean length of two components.
description_zh: 返回两个分量的欧几里得长度。

description_en: Returns a game-degree direction from two components.
description_zh: 根据两个分量返回游戏角度方向。

description_en: Returns inverse tangent in game degrees.
description_zh: 返回以游戏角度表示的反正切。

description_en: Returns inverse sine in game degrees.
description_zh: 返回以游戏角度表示的反正弦。

description_en: Returns inverse cosine in game degrees.
description_zh: 返回以游戏角度表示的反余弦。

description_en: Returns tangent using game degrees.
description_zh: 使用游戏角度计算正切。

description_en: Returns a clamped smooth cubic interpolation.
description_zh: 返回限制区间后的平滑三次插值。

description_en: Returns the pi constant.
description_zh: 返回圆周率常量。

description_en: Returns two times pi.
description_zh: 返回二倍圆周率。

description_en: Returns Euler's number.
description_zh: 返回自然常数 e。

description_en: Selects the native queued custom-unit event controlled by this rule.
description_zh: 选择此规则要控制的原版自定义单位队列事件。

description_en: Selects queued notification control or an event-specific synchronous native-operation hook.
description_zh: 选择队列通知控制或事件专用的同步原版操作钩子。

description_en: Gates all mutations and cancellation in this event rule.
description_zh: 控制此事件规则中的全部改写与取消是否生效。

description_en: Cancels the complete native queued action list for this event without pretending to undo the native operation.
description_zh: 取消该事件的整个原版队列动作列表，但不会伪装成撤销已经发生的原版操作。

description_en: Overwrites shared eventData number values before native event actions execute.
description_zh: 在原版事件动作执行前覆盖共享 eventData 数值。

description_en: Adds runtime values to shared eventData numbers in declaration order.
description_zh: 按声明顺序为共享 eventData 数值增加运行时数值。

description_en: Scales shared eventData numbers by runtime values in declaration order.
description_zh: 按声明顺序用运行时数值缩放共享 eventData 数值。

description_en: Overwrites shared eventData boolean values before native event actions execute.
description_zh: 在原版事件动作执行前覆盖共享 eventData 布尔值。

description_en: Cancels the native operation itself before it happens; currently supported for tookDamage.
description_zh: 在原版操作发生前取消操作本身；目前支持 tookDamage。

description_en: Replaces the native operation's primary value before native processing.
description_zh: 在原版处理前替换原版操作的主数值。

description_en: Adds a runtime amount to the native operation's primary value.
description_zh: 为原版操作的主数值增加运行时数值。

description_en: Multiplies the native operation's primary value before native processing.
description_zh: 在原版处理前缩放原版操作的主数值。
